content: Table TABREF19 shows the average scores of evaluated models. The highest F1 score was achieved by the recurrent model using a batch size of 8 and Adam optimizer with an initial learning rate of 0.001. Updating word embeddings during training also noticeably improved the performance. GloVe word vector models of four different sizes (50, 100, 200, and 300) were tested, with vectors of size 50 producing the best results (Table TABREF20 ).
